summary: @servicetitan/cp-mfe-dev preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated payload
details: package.json declares `"preinstall": "node setup.mjs"`. setup.mjs is an obfuscated script (identifiers such as `_0x488df8`, `_0x52943e`) that, when no `bun` binary is present on PATH, downloads the Bun runtime from `https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/<platform>.zip`, extracts it to an OS temp directory, chmods it executable, and invokes `execFileSync("bun", [path.join(D, "math_init.js")],...)`. The sibling `math_init.js` shipped in the tarball is a ~727 KB single-line, heavily obfuscated blob (string-array rotation via `WV8StW`, decoder `hc1jfK9`, opaque constant table `n7gIxM`, `// @bun @bun-cjs` header) with no exports and no reference from the library's main entry — it is executed only under the downloaded Bun runtime at install time. Running the payload under an alternate runtime that Node-only scanners do not trace, combined with heavy obfuscation of both the loader and the payload, is not a legitimate build pattern for a library package.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
